info.syllabusName: Trách nhiệm xã hội của doanh nghiệp (Corporate social responsibility)
info.description:
The course gives learners an overview of the key issues of CSR and the challenges businesses are facing when putting CSR principles into practice. The course examines corporate social responsibility practices and how to balance business and CSR. The course helps learners to identify which activities are CSR, make related decisions and how to communicate about CSR to the target audience. The course also introduces some cases related to sustainable development and the role of enterprises in this development.
The course covers issues on the relationship between business, society and government, environmental issues, corporate governance, management aspects related to society and business ethics, understanding stakeholders (the public of the business), their needs and the challenges that the business meets the new requirements of society.
The course will provide learners with the knowledge and skills to enhance the sustainability and value of businesses. Learners will have the opportunity to solve a number of real-life situations on CSR, business ethics and accountability to the public inside and outside of the business.
